name: I Became a Proper Member of Society and Got a Girlfriend Before Graduation?!
source:
"If I believed in Santa Claus for ten whole years, then I can believe in myself for the next ten seconds!!!"

Hikigaya Komori grew up in the middle of nowhere and learned everything she knows about human behavior and social dynamics from reading books and playing dating sims.

Through a series of happenstances and misunderstandings, she ends up crossing paths with Kohinata Koharu, former student council president and resident popular girl.

Setting aside the fact that Komori doesn't believe in genuine altruism, she can't figure out why someone at the top of the pecking order would rub shoulders with a lowly ant like her...

But for the longest time, she has wanted to change... if only she could.

Now that she can, the opportunity is paired with the harrowing realization that rest of her youth depends on Koharu's opinion of her. Now, she must decide whether she can grow out of her shell or face tragedy.

A thriving social life might be a bit of a stretch, but surely, she can manage to make a few friends, right?

...Right??

translation:
“如果我能相信圣诞老人整整10年，那接下来10秒里，我也能相信自己！！”

小森Hikigaya在偏远地区长大，她对人类行为和社交关系的理解，全都来自读书和玩恋爱模拟游戏。

经过一连串偶然与误会，她遇见了前学生会长、校园人气女孩小日向Koharu。

先不说小森并不相信真诚的利他主义，她就是不明白，为什么站在食物链顶端的人会和她这种低贱的蚂蚁来往……

但她一直很想改变……只要她做得到。

如今机会终于来了，但随之而来的可怕现实是：她剩余的青春都取决于Koharu对她的看法。她必须决定自己能否走出封闭状态，否则就要面对悲剧。

丰富的社交生活或许有点困难，但交几个朋友总可以吧？

……对吧？[改写自[url=https://studiochuunibyou.itch.io/i-became-a-proper-member-of-society-and-got-a-girlfriend-before-graduation]Itch.io[/url]]
